summary: Ondas Inc. completed the acquisition of Mistral, Inc. via a merger of its wholly owned subsidiary, Merger Sub, with Mistral, effective April 24, 2026. Total consideration is approximately $175 million, comprising 1,567,735 shares of Ondas common stock issued upfront, with additional shares held in escrow for post-closing adjustments and deferred consideration released over three years, plus a $150 million Additional Consideration tranche issued in six installments post-closing. The registrant (Ondas) serves as acquirer; no board recommendation or advisor is named. Stockholder Shoshana Banai receives registration rights for resale. Watch for stock price reaction to the issuance overhang and execution risk around the deferred consideration milestones.
